verdict.line: You lose if you let Jax dictate trades around his Leap Strike and Counter Strike cooldowns; you win if you survive lane using wall zoning and wave control, since the raw numbers (48.6% over 1141 games) land close to even despite his lane and solo-kill edge.

brief.thesis: Jax's E (Counter Strike) dodges all incoming basic attacks before stunning and damaging anyone nearby, which directly counters Yorick's Q (Last Rites) plan of landing an empowered auto to heal and dig a grave. Both his Q (Leap Strike, 17s cooldown at rank 1) and E (Counter Strike, 18s at rank 1) are long on cooldown early, so there are real dead windows where he can't punish or escape you — those are the only moments worth committing. Outside those windows Yorick's W (Dark Procession) wall and E (Mourning Mist) poke are what keep the lane from bleeding out.

theirWindow.when: he leaps in with Q or raises E
theirWindow.what: If he just used Leap Strike to close or is entering the Counter Strike stance, do not throw out Q (Last Rites) autos — landing hits on him mid-E does nothing but exposes you to the stun and follow-up damage. Disengage or bait the stance out with a minion first.

yourWindow.when: both his Q and E are down
yourWindow.what: Per OP.GG's own read on this lane, Jax leans on Q to close and reset range and E to punish or escape; when both are on cooldown he has no dash and no dodge-stun, so step in, land Q (Last Rites) on your next auto, and chain E (Mourning Mist) to poke, slow, and strip his armor.

start.why: Measured at 47.8% over 556 games; the passive block and regen directly answer Jax's auto-reliant poke and Empower-weaved trades in a lane where he has the solo-kill edge.

boots.why: 70.1% pick rate at 49.3% win rate; the flat auto-attack reduction blunts both his Empower-boosted hits and the attack-speed strings from Relentless Assault.

core.why: Gives you the burst and mobility to actually land Q (Last Rites) procs and close distance Jax tries to deny with Leap Strike.
The cooldown reduction means more frequent E (Mourning Mist) pokes and faster Q resets, which matters most during the Q/E-down windows you're fighting for.
Armor pen and the slow help you stick on him during extended fights, since he otherwise kites range with Leap Strike resets.

situational.when: he starts stacking armor to blunt your trades
he's committing hard to all-ins and you need to survive the Counter Strike stun window
the game turns into a side-lane split-push stalemate

runes.keystoneWhy: Measured at 49.8% win rate here, the highest of the two listed pages; the stacking adaptive force and healing let you win the auto-for-auto exchanges Jax forces instead of relying on a single early proc.

summoners.why: Flash + Ignite measures highest in this matchup at 50.6% because it lets you punish Jax hard inside his Q/E-down window instead of just surviving it; Flash + Teleport is the more popular pick (53%) if you're leaning on wave control and side-lane pressure to close the gap he opens in lane.

playing.title: Only commit when Q and E are down
playing.detail: Jax uses Leap Strike to close, Empowers a hit, then Leap Strike again to reset range; step in only when both are on cooldown so he can't punish your Q (Last Rites) or simply dash away.

playing.title: Never auto into Counter Strike
playing.detail: His E dodges all incoming basic attacks before stunning and damaging you; if he enters the stance, cancel your planned Q and back off instead of feeding free autos into it.

playing.title: Wall his Leap Strike engage
playing.detail: Drop W (Dark Procession) right as he leaps in, or as he tries to reset distance with Leap Strike; the wall blocks movement outright and can strand him on your side of the lane.

playing.title: Poke with Mourning Mist on cooldown
playing.detail: E (Mourning Mist) drops to an 8-second cooldown at max rank — use it every time it's up to chip HP, cut his armor, and slow him before any bigger commitment.

playing.title: Win trades fast or not at all
playing.detail: His R (Relentless Assault) has no cooldown and ramps attack speed with every strike, with every third hit dealing bonus damage; the longer an auto-trade runs, the worse it gets for you.

playing.title: Farm graves for sidelane pressure
playing.detail: Q (Last Rites) digs a grave on any champion hit; stack these during his cooldown windows to build Mist Walker pressure, since the even overall numbers here come from Yorick closing the gap through wave control, not lane dominance.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and win rates above are pulled directly from measured OP.GG games on the current patch; the trade-timing and mechanical reads on Jax's Counter Strike, Leap Strike, and Relentless Assault windows are my own tactical analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: If Jax closes in with (Q) to use his (E), use [E] to retreat. Try to fight Jax when he has both (Q) and (E) on cooldown. He will use (Q) to close in, deal damage, and (Q) again to retreat. Use [E] and [P] to poke while waiting for (E) and (Q) to be on cooldown to kill him.
